# External Maclisp documentation — manifest

Collected 2026-11-19 from public archives. Documents whose terms forbid copying are listed under "Not downloaded (link only)" at the end.



License column vocabulary: *public domain / explicit permission (quoted) / openly archived, no explicit license / DO NOT REDISTRIBUTE*. "Openly archived, no explicit license" means the copyright holder (usually MIT) has not granted a license; the scan is merely publicly hosted by a recognised archive.
